'''Always Pokémon''' is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S03|third season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[EP106]] (from [[EP117]] in the first airing) to [[EP157]].

The opening animation featured footage from the third English opening, [[Pokémon Johto]], and clips from various episodes of the season.

The original, two-minute footage of this opening was not used in later airings as Mediaset, the company in charge of the Italian dub at the time, lost it. In Mediaset reruns of these episodes, footage from [[Pokémon: Beyond the Skies of the Adventure]] and a shorter, one-minute version of the music of Always Pokémon were used. However, the ending version kept the original footage.

==Trivia==
* The full version of the opening animation used a scene of {{Ash}} throwing a [[Safari Ball]] from the [[Banned episodes|banned episode]] [[EP035]], which was included from a sequence featured in the [[2.B.A. Master]] music video segment.
* This is the first Italian opening theme for the TV series to feature a duet. In the original Japanese version, the first TV opening theme to feature a duet is [[High Touch!]], while in the English dub it's {{so|Black and White}}.
